primary_focus: Shopify apps, AI replacement of specific app functions, one-prompt builds, and a merchant prompt library
cadence: Superseded November 7: default to three distinct Shopify/app/merchant-AI articles per daily batch; Whop is occasional, not required. Preserve minimum and quality checks. See shopify-ai-newsletter-priority-2026-11-07.md.

items.title: Shopify merchant prompt library
items.brief: Create an ungated searchable library with copyable prompts, tool labels, inputs, expected output, and acceptance checks. Start with 20 useful prompts; no separate thin page for each prompt.

items.title: Which Shopify app functions can you replace with AI?
items.brief: A build-versus-buy decision by function, including maintenance, hosting, support, and rollback. Compare native features first, then Flow, theme code, admin apps, and specialist apps.

items.title: One prompt to a Shopify admin app: a catalog QA dashboard
items.brief: One narrowly scoped, read-only initial prompt. Record first output, errors, revisions, and validation separately. Explain Sidekick admin-only scope; no production-ready guarantee.

items.title: Build a Shopify app with Claude Code
items.brief: Revalidate current scaffolding and AI Toolkit, remove unsupported timing/cost guarantees, and use a reproducible dev-store example. Existing article is the developer path, not a duplicate of Sidekick.
items.note: Current React Router scaffold and AI Toolkit plugin; unsupported timing/price guarantees removed. No executed merchant build claimed.

items.title: Replace a simple size-chart app with a theme section
items.brief: Original theme-section prompt and measurement mapping. Verify accessibility, mobile, variants and localization. Do not claim Sidekick-generated admin apps render on the storefront.
items.note: Published as a named-app, limited-function replacement guide with copyable prompts, free-plan alternatives and hypothetical net savings.

items.title: Replace a basic announcement-bar app with theme code
items.brief: Define the limited display requirement, editor settings and keyboard behavior. Distinguish static messaging from targeting, scheduling, experimentation and analytics.
items.note: Published as a named-app, limited-function replacement guide with copyable prompts, free-plan alternatives and hypothetical net savings.

items.title: Build a missing-product-data checker with AI
items.brief: Read-only product audit for missing facts; explain pagination, variants, empty fields and review output. Export a review list before offering bulk updates.
items.note: Read-only missing-description/image checker is the example in the one-prompt article. Expand that article only with new evidence instead of creating a second page for the same intent.

items.title: Shopify Flow, Sidekick app, or custom app?
items.brief: Choose by trigger, interface, data surface, ongoing execution and maintenance; verify current capabilities and plan limits.

items.title: The real cost of replacing a Shopify app with AI
items.brief: Worked build-versus-subscription worksheet including implementation, hosting, maintenance, updates and support; no invented savings.

items.title: Test an AI-built Shopify app before installing it
items.brief: Permissions, tenant isolation where applicable, read/write boundaries, failure cases, rollback, and reproducible evidence.

items.title: Keep, replace, or remove: audit your Shopify app stack
items.brief: Map each paid app to actually used functions and dependencies; inspect export and cancellation requirements before removing anything.

items.title: When a specialist Shopify app is worth keeping
items.brief: Evaluate subscriptions, loyalty balances, returns, reviews and tax complexity; recommend maintained specialist tooling where appropriate, with verified program status.

prompt_library.sample_prompt: Build a read-only Shopify admin app that lists products missing descriptions or product images. Show product title, status and the specific missing fields. Include a link to review each product. Do not edit products or request write access. Explain pagination and unsupported fields. Show an empty state when nothing is missing. List the checks needed before installation.
prompt_library.sample_status: Original editorial prompt; not run or verified

sources.finding: Generated apps operate in admin, not themes, checkout or customer account apps. Eligible plans and usage limits need current checks; generation and refinement are separate.
Current developer tooling provides official documentation, schemas and code validation for supported AI tools.

conversion_policy: Existing merchants should receive relevant app recommendations only with verified owned partner links. Shopify merchant signup CTAs belong in prospective-store contexts; replacing an app is not a new Shopify referral. Whop links belong in relevant Whop paths, not every Shopify AI prompt.
measurement: Use the existing private baseline for AI theme/app pages. Track organic clicks, prompt usage once instrumented, provider outbound clicks, qualified referrals and commissions separately. No invented search volume or savings.
quality: One-shot describes the initial build attempt, not guaranteed live-store readiness. Publish actual build evidence only when available; otherwise label illustrative prompts. Do not clone proprietary app code or claim feature parity from a similar screen. No email gating, printing, paid tool purchases or live-store mutations.
newsletter_priority: Optional opt-in newsletter acquisition authorized November 7; prompt library remains ungated. Measure confirmed active subscribers separately from referrals and revenue.
